interface.name: wl_display
interface.description: The core global object. This is a special singleton object.

request.name: sync
request.description: The sync request asks the server to emit the 'done' event on the returned wl_callback object.

request.name: get_registry
request.description: This request creates a registry object that allows the client to list and bind global interfaces.

event.name: error
event.description: The error event is sent out when a fatal (non-recoverable) error has occurred.

event.name: delete_id
event.description: This event indicates that the numerical ID for an object is now reusable.

interface.name: wl_compositor
interface.description: A compositor. This object is a singleton global.

request.name: create_surface
request.description: Ask the compositor to create a new surface.
